parsed.note: DEPTH=12 is a plain hyperparameter change that leaves the fixed evaluation block and TRAIN_SHARDS (which still excludes eval shard 7) untouched, so val_bpb keeps measuring real quality—though the posted numbers look reversed since 1.078 is worse than the prior 1.060.
